research.title: Object Detection Robustness Under Image Degradation
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare object detector sensitivity to motion blur, compression artifacts, and reduced illumination using controlled image transformations.
Evaluated detection precision and recall across degradation conditions, inspecting missed detections by object size and documenting limitations of synthetic corruption tests.

research.title: Foreground Segmentation with Limited Training Annotations
bullets: Planned comparisons with supervisor guidance to examine how annotation availability and augmentation choices affect foreground segmentation under consistent training and validation splits.
Trained encoder-decoder segmentation baselines and analyzed overlap metrics alongside boundary errors, separating failures involving thin structures from those involving background texture.

work.title: Inventory and Order Documentation Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing documents, recorded stock discrepancies, and routed unresolved quantity or item mismatches to the responsible staff.
Maintained order paperwork, organized routine filing, and coordinated collection schedules with colleagues to support daily stock handling and dispatch activities.

projects.title: Image Classification with Handcrafted and Learned Features
bullets: Implemented image classification pipelines using histogram of oriented gradients with a linear classifier and a convolutional neural network on a shared dataset.
Compared validation accuracy and confusion patterns under consistent data splits, examining sensitivity to image normalization and augmentation while documenting training configuration differences.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Stereo Matching Methods
bullets: Implemented local block matching and semi-global matching for rectified stereo images, examining disparity estimates across textured, low-texture, and occluded regions.
Compared disparity errors against available reference maps and inspected artifacts near depth discontinuities, varying matching window sizes and smoothness penalties.
